segment.source: The Faceless are here!<end>
segment.target: The Faceless are here!<end>

segment.source: Magnificent Tchort! What are you doing here, $(#brother/sister)? The kitchen is for staff ONLY!<end>
segment.target: Magnificent Tchort! What are you doing here, $(#brother/sister)? The kitchen is for staff ONLY!<end>

segment.source:
::The man behind the counter strikes you as being calm, friendly and radiates a positive attitude. Appearance-wise, young and handsome are the words that describe him most accurate, while his confident posture is also difficult to ignore. He greets you with a familiar Tchortist salute.::
Tchort is evolution, $(#brother/sister). My name is Theodore, often called Theo by... by almost everyone. ::He smiles.:: How may I help you?<end>
segment.target:
::The man behind the counter strikes you as being calm, friendly and radiates a positive attitude. Appearance-wise, young and handsome are the words that describe him most accurate, while his confident posture is also difficult to ignore. He greets you with a familiar Tchortist salute.::
Tchort is evolution, $(#brother/sister). My name is Theodore, often called Theo by... by almost everyone. ::He smiles.:: How may I help you?<end>

segment.source: Evolution is Tchort, brother. I'm $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: Evolution is Tchort, brother. I'm $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: Welcome to the Institute of Tchort, $(#brother/sister). Our institution is very different from those on the outside I'm sure, but you'll get used to it, don't worry.<end>
segment.target: Welcome to the Institute of Tchort, $(#brother/sister). Our institution is very different from those on the outside I'm sure, but you'll get used to it, don't worry.<end>

segment.source: <end>
segment.target: <end>

segment.source: Show me what you got. I'm starving!<end>
segment.target: Show me what you got. I'm starving!<end>

segment.source: Today's we have...<end>
segment.target: Today's we have...<end>

segment.source: ::Barter.::<end>
segment.target: ::Barter.::<end>

segment.source: Show me what you got. I'm starving! ::Barter.::<end>
segment.target: Show me what you got. I'm starving! ::Barter.::<end>

segment.source: How and why did you join Institute of Tchort?<end>
segment.target: How and why did you join Institute of Tchort?<end>

segment.source: I am institute-born, $(#brother/sister). It wasn't my decision to become a Tchortist, but with all the things I heard about the outside world, I'm better off. Life here is better without a doubt, and here people care about each other, care about progress - evolution, rather than just about their own hide, so to speak.<end>
segment.target: I am institute-born, $(#brother/sister). It wasn't my decision to become a Tchortist, but with all the things I heard about the outside world, I'm better off. Life here is better without a doubt, and here people care about each other, care about progress - evolution, rather than just about their own hide, so to speak.<end>

segment.source: Wait, you never left this building?<end>
segment.target: Wait, you never left this building?<end>

segment.source: No. Again, from what I heard in the past... I'm better off being here.<end>
segment.target: No. Again, from what I heard in the past... I'm better off being here.<end>

segment.source: Maybe I can share a few stories about the outside world. It's rough alright, but not everything is so grim. There is much beauty outside of the Institute.<end>
segment.target: Maybe I can share a few stories about the outside world. It's rough alright, but not everything is so grim. There is much beauty outside of the Institute.<end>

segment.source: Maybe some other time, $(#brother/sister); now's not the time. Anything else you needed? And please, let's make it quick, refectory is always a busy place.<end>
segment.target: Maybe some other time, $(#brother/sister); now's not the time. Anything else you needed? And please, let's make it quick, refectory is always a busy place.<end>

segment.source: Interesting... I had other questions though.<end>
segment.target: Interesting... I had other questions though.<end>

segment.source: Yes, what?<end>
segment.target: Yes, what?<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about the Faceless?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about the Faceless?<end>

segment.source: Keep the Faceless out of the refectory please, people are trying to eat here.<end>
segment.target: Keep the Faceless out of the refectory please, people are trying to eat here.<end>

segment.source: Magnificent Tchort! Stop mentioning those... those vomit-inducing freaks here - we are trying to eat!<end>
segment.target: Magnificent Tchort! Stop mentioning those... those vomit-inducing freaks here - we are trying to eat!<end>

segment.source: That's what I was talking about...<end>
segment.target: That's what I was talking about...<end>

segment.source: What can you tell me about the West Wing?<end>
segment.target: What can you tell me about the West Wing?<end>

segment.source: It is dangerous, do not go there.<end>
segment.target: It is dangerous, do not go there.<end>

segment.source: It is that simple, $(#brother/sister).<end>
segment.target: It is that simple, $(#brother/sister).<end>

segment.source: But what is so dangerous about it?<end>
segment.target: But what is so dangerous about it?<end>

segment.source: I am sorry but I can't explain it now, $(#brother/sister) - this is neither the time nor the place for that. This is where people eat and I have got my hands a bit busy at the moment.<end>
segment.target: I am sorry but I can't explain it now, $(#brother/sister) - this is neither the time nor the place for that. This is where people eat and I have got my hands a bit busy at the moment.<end>

segment.source:
Just trust me... it is dangerous; there is a reason no one goes there.
Now, $(#brother/sister), are you ordering something or not?<end>
segment.target:
Just trust me... it is dangerous; there is a reason no one goes there.
Now, $(#brother/sister), are you ordering something or not?<end>

segment.source: Understood. Let me ask you something else.<end>
segment.target: Understood. Let me ask you something else.<end>

segment.source: Hey, do you want to hear a joke?<end>
segment.target: Hey, do you want to hear a joke?<end>

segment.source: Is it the one about a cell undergoing mitosis?<end>
segment.target: Is it the one about a cell undergoing mitosis?<end>

segment.source: No, it's about a rathound that walks into a bar - and the barkeeper shoots the filthy thing!<end>
segment.target: No, it's about a rathound that walks into a bar - and the barkeeper shoots the filthy thing!<end>

segment.source: ::He laughs.:: 'Cause everyone hates rathounds! Yes, I like that one.<end>
segment.target: ::He laughs.:: 'Cause everyone hates rathounds! Yes, I like that one.<end>

segment.source: Apex joke, $(#brother/sister).<end>
segment.target: Apex joke, $(#brother/sister).<end>

segment.source: Erm, yes it is...<end>
segment.target: Erm, yes it is...<end>

segment.source: Sorry, $(#brother/sister), already heard that one. One of the genetics investigators already told it to me.<end>
segment.target: Sorry, $(#brother/sister), already heard that one. One of the genetics investigators already told it to me.<end>

segment.source: Need anything else?<end>
segment.target: Need anything else?<end>

segment.source: I would like to ask you some questions about Tchortism.<end>
segment.target: I would like to ask you some questions about Tchortism.<end>

segment.source: I'm sorry, but I'm working at the moment, and a discussion about Tchortism would take too long.<end>
segment.target: I'm sorry, but I'm working at the moment, and a discussion about Tchortism would take too long.<end>

segment.source: Seek Praepostor Amelia, or visit Eidein's Library. Oh, and read the Original Report if you haven't already.<end>
segment.target: Seek Praepostor Amelia, or visit Eidein's Library. Oh, and read the Original Report if you haven't already.<end>

segment.source: Hi, I'd like one cute Theo for takeout. Hot if possible.<end>
segment.target: Hi, I'd like one cute Theo for takeout. Hot if possible.<end>

segment.source: Sorry, we are not serving Theo today. Are you perhaps interested in something else?<end>
segment.target: Sorry, we are not serving Theo today. Are you perhaps interested in something else?<end>

segment.source: Hopper stew is hot too, sister.<end>
segment.target: Hopper stew is hot too, sister.<end>

segment.source: Hi, I wanted to ask you something really important, but was stunned by how handsome you are. Now I can't remember.<end>
segment.target: Hi, I wanted to ask you something really important, but was stunned by how handsome you are. Now I can't remember.<end>

segment.source: That happens pretty often actually, so don't worry about it.<end>
segment.target: That happens pretty often actually, so don't worry about it.<end>

segment.source: While you're trying to remember, maybe grab something to eat, sister?<end>
segment.target: While you're trying to remember, maybe grab something to eat, sister?<end>

segment.source: ::Wave and wink at him seductively.::<end>
segment.target: ::Wave and wink at him seductively.::<end>

segment.source: ::He waves back and leans forward slightly, as if he is going to wink. However, he stops, eyes wide open. Then, he shrugs his shoulders.::<end>
segment.target: ::He waves back and leans forward slightly, as if he is going to wink. However, he stops, eyes wide open. Then, he shrugs his shoulders.::<end>

segment.source: Oh no, I guess we are out of winks. How about hopper stew?<end>
segment.target: Oh no, I guess we are out of winks. How about hopper stew?<end>

segment.source: I'm new to the Institute of Tchort. Could you give me directions to your room?<end>
segment.target: I'm new to the Institute of Tchort. Could you give me directions to your room?<end>

segment.source: Certainly, exit the refectory, up the stairs, then take four left turns, down the stairs and then turn right.<end>
segment.target: Certainly, exit the refectory, up the stairs, then take four left turns, down the stairs and then turn right.<end>

segment.source: See you soon, sister!<end>
segment.target: See you soon, sister!<end>

segment.source: My lips hurt! Will you kiss them and make the pain go away?<end>
segment.target: My lips hurt! Will you kiss them and make the pain go away?<end>

segment.source: You know, sister, maybe I can help you with that...<end>
segment.target: You know, sister, maybe I can help you with that...<end>

segment.source: Oh?<end>
segment.target: Oh?<end>

segment.source: Or, I better leave it to the professional. Jerre-Franz's medical office is right past the sleeping quarters; he'll give you something for the pain. Trust me, he is the best.<end>
segment.target: Or, I better leave it to the professional. Jerre-Franz's medical office is right past the sleeping quarters; he'll give you something for the pain. Trust me, he is the best.<end>

segment.source: I give up...<end>
segment.target: I give up...<end>

segment.source: Hungry?<end>
segment.target: Hungry?<end>

segment.source: ::Leave without saying anything.::<end>
segment.target: ::Leave without saying anything.::<end>

segment.source: Really?<end>
segment.target: Really?<end>

segment.source: ::Pout your lips.::<end>
segment.target: ::Pout your lips.::<end>

segment.source: See you next time, Theo.<end>
segment.target: See you next time, Theo.<end>

segment.source: Tchort guides, $(#brother/sister).<end>
segment.target: Tchort guides, $(#brother/sister).<end>

segment.source: I'm $(context.player.Name) and I'm very, very hungry.<end>
segment.target: I'm $(context.player.Name) and I'm very, very hungry.<end>

segment.source: ::He laughs.:: Don't worry, $(#brother/sister), we'll fill that belly of yours in just a moment. What'll it be?<end>
segment.target: ::He laughs.:: Don't worry, $(#brother/sister), we'll fill that belly of yours in just a moment. What'll it be?<end>

segment.source: Hi, Theo. I'm $(#brother/sister) $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: Hi, Theo. I'm $(#brother/sister) $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: Tchort is handsome... I mean you're evolution... You're handsome! That's the one! And I'm $(context.player.Name).<end>
segment.target: Tchort is handsome... I mean you're evolution... You're handsome! That's the one! And I'm $(context.player.Name).<end>

segment.source: Uhm... While I should thank you for the compliment, our greeting is not something that should be twisted in such a manner. Please, make sure you always say the phrase in its proper form.<end>
segment.target: Uhm... While I should thank you for the compliment, our greeting is not something that should be twisted in such a manner. Please, make sure you always say the phrase in its proper form.<end>

segment.source: I understand. Still, you're handsome.<end>
segment.target: I understand. Still, you're handsome.<end>

segment.source: That I am. ::Smiles:: What'll it be, $(context.player.Name)?<end>
segment.target: That I am. ::Smiles:: What'll it be, $(context.player.Name)?<end>

segment.source: I'm very sorry. Won't happen again.<end>
segment.target: I'm very sorry. Won't happen again.<end>

segment.source: Apology accepted. Now, what'll it be, $(context.player.Name)?<end>
segment.target: Apology accepted. Now, what'll it be, $(context.player.Name)?<end>

segment.source: Hungry again, $(#brother/sister)?<end>
segment.target: Hungry again, $(#brother/sister)?<end>
